summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 2 in Preterit (57/124)

data.turoyo: Koṯe komə lu darbo, d friqi (+det) hiye w ann aḥunone a tre m ḥḏoḏe, kḥoze ġayr mi xuṣayḏe, layt taḥt i kefo. A tre aḥunonayḏe daʕiri.
data.translation: Er kam zu dem Wege, wo er sich von seinen beiden Brüdern getrennt hatte. Da sah er, daß außer dem seinigen kein Ring unter dem Steine war. Seine beiden Brüder waren umgekehrt.

rationale: New Detransitive Preterit box: reciprocal separation, with the source’s (+det) annotation retained verbatim.

summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 1.2/14)

data.turoyo: Koṯən an noše, kubənne ǧəġarat, bəṯr maǧ ǧəġarat ksaymənne qaḥwe mayərto w xaṣ w ʕam kmifarqo, <...>
data.translation: Die Leute kommen, und man gibt ihnen Zigaretten. Nach dem Rauchen und macht man ihnen bitteren Kaffee, der an jedermann ausgeschenkt wird. <...>

rationale: New II Detransitive Infectum box and sense: distributed coffee is the theme.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JTM 2.5/7)

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 6 in Infectum-wa (Jan 1.50/2372)

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 4 in Infectum-wa (Jan 2.3/442)

data.translation: I used not to distinguish between the word Safarbarlik [mobilisation] and Sayfo [the Sword, the genocide]. I used to think the two were one.

summary: New box Preterit: example for sense 2 in Preterit (Jan 1.7/130)

rationale: Thin Detransitive 2 Preterit cell already opened in round 1; family branching and first-person plural.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 1.26/1274)

data.turoyo: Kətwolan qaṭʕo d sawal, maydowa i zəbdo, han naqqa uṯanwo di šawṯo, mfarqowa ad dawġe lu ʕamo.
data.translation: We had a herd of livestock; she would take the butter, then she would come to the neighbourhood and distribute the buttermilk to the people.

rationale: Thin II.1 Infectum-wa cell already opened in round 1; feminine distributor and l-recipients.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 1.36/1526)

data.turoyo: ʕAmmo Išoʕ aḥna naʕime, uṯewo u ḥalwano u ʕamariqani du tuz, mfarqiwolanyo, maštanwolanyo.
data.translation: Uncle Isho, when we were children, the American powdered milk used to come; they would distribute it to us and give it to us to drink.

rationale: Thin II.1 Infectum-wa cell; distinct first-person recipient -lan and theme -yo suffixes.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 2.5/1568)

data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: Aaa! Bas sanduqe wayye aš šamʕe, ġalabe sayminawo. Mqaṭʕinawo kul šamʕo haqqayṣ, mfarqinawonne, kul ḥa, ḥa lašan d maqiṯi.
data.translation: Khori Brahim: Ah! The candles were in boxes and boxes; we used to make very many. We used to cut each candle to its measure; we used to distribute them, one to each person, so that they could light them.

rationale: Thin II.1 Infectum-wa cell; first-person plural distributor and one candle per recipient.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 2.12/3158)

data.turoyo: Lə koṯe l boli d mzabanlan. Mfarqinawole ʕal u ahl. I ʕade hawxa wa.
data.translation: It does not come to my mind that we sold it. We distributed it among the family. That was the custom.

rationale: Brings II.1 Infectum-wa to five with round 1; contrasts ʕal-recipient group and l-recipients. Elided commodity remains elided in both texts.

summary: New sense 4: (mit m- / m ḥḏoḏe) voneinander unterscheiden, auseinanderhalten

data.gloss: (mit m- / m ḥḏoḏe) voneinander unterscheiden, auseinanderhalten

rationale: An agent discriminates compared entities, often with reciprocal separation phrase; unlike impersonal einen Unterschied machen or noticing a fact. Numbering remains unchanged.

summary: New sense 5: intrans. sich trennen, fortgehen; jemanden verlassen

data.gloss: intrans. sich trennen, fortgehen; jemanden verlassen

rationale: Active frəqla and koforəq denote parting; the latter takes an overt person counterpart, whereas existing separation was filed only under Detransitive 2.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) verteilt werden
rationale: First II Detransitive example: coffee is distributed, no agent expressed; matches active II verteilen.

summary: New sense 6: trennen, voneinander absondern (Personen, Gruppen, Stoffe)
rationale: Separating people or sorting grain fractions is an agent-caused separation, distinct from inherited hair splitting I.1, difference I.2, noticing I.3 and round-1 discrimination I.4 or departure I.5. Number after round-1 I.5.

summary: example for sense 4 in Infectum (JTM 1.1/63)

data.translation: Der gute Schnitter unterscheidet sie voneinander und kennt sie.

summary: example for sense 4 in Infectum (MAC Ishaq old houses/30)

data.translation: Like, you have seen stones outside, no? You can no longer distinguish the stones and the cement from each other.

rationale: New sense: overt compared stone/cement objects with me-ḥḏoḏe; short complete context.

summary: example for sense 4 in Infectum (69/506)

data.turoyo: Ad dawsat d Ǧanpola i dawse du ʕulmo ṣiṭo yo. I dawsayḏe xi dawse di gamlo, d fərqat du arwono m ḥḏoḏe, aydarbo yo, hiye i dawsayḏe hawxa mbayanto wa m du ʕulmo.
data.translation: Die Fußspuren von Stahlherz die Spur gewöhnlicher Menschen ist eine Spanne lang; seine Spur aber Unterschied sich von der gewöhnlicher Menschen so, wie du die Spur des Kameles von der des Kalbes unterscheidest.

rationale: New sense: footprints provide an independent comparison domain.

summary: example for sense 5 in Preterit (88/63)

data.turoyo: Ftəḥla u=tarʕo w haṯe maḥtola lawġul w i=sawto frəqla w azzayo.
data.translation: da machte sie die Türe auf, setzte das Mädchen hinein, trennte sich dann von ihm und ging.

rationale: New active departure sense in Preterit.

summary: example for sense 5 in Infectum (89/104)

data.turoyo: Hano koforəq a=tloṯo=aḥunone, kəzzé l i=dayira d at=taḥarriye. Am=mabaḥəṯ d i=Qaməšlo.

summary: example for sense 3 in Infectum (MAC MuA Quzko/59)

data.turoyo: Komofəq u+qa+laḥmawo me tamo, komičək bi+xurǧk̇e ŭ maḥət tarte+ṭalme, tlaṯ+laḥmo ʕal qarʕe druḥe, dnoše lo+forəq ebe.
data.translation: He takes out so much of that bread, he sneaks into the bag and puts two loaves, three loaves on his own head, so people wouldn’t pick him out.

rationale: First Infectum example for existing sense 3: b-coded person noticed or recognised.

summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (JTM 5.1/12)

data.turoyo: aʕmayye kuxlo, aʕmayye kšutyo, aʕmayye qqaymo, lə gfuraqla mi barṯo, həngi d kətyo zʕurto ḥalal.
data.translation: Sie aß mit ihnen, trank mit ihnen, teilte ihren Tagesablauf. Er behandelte sie nicht anders als eine Tochter, weil sie so ein anständiges Mädchen war.

rationale: Thin sense-2 Infectum cell: personal comparison rather than impersonal difference.

summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (MAC Ishaq Material culture/92)

data.turoyo: Quṭʕiwa qayso yarixo, taqriban ʕaṣro+sanṭime ḥlimo, mnaǧríwayle mgarvno, tre ŭ falge, tloṯo yurxo, lo+g̊forəq.
data.translation: They would cut a long log, approximately 10 centimetres thick, fashion (lit. ‘carpenter’) it round, two and a half, three (meters) in length, it doesn’t matter.

rationale: Thin sense-2 Infectum cell: impersonal irrelevance of a measurement.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (JTM 1.3/14)

data.turoyo: kul ḥa kəmfarəq laq qaryayḏe, lani d koṯən lašan u ṭlobo, w kəmdawmo i ʕadaṯe baynoṯayye.
data.translation: Jeder verteilt sie unter seinen Gästen, die zu der Verlobung gekommen sind. Diese Sitte besteht noch bei uns weiter.

rationale: Thin II Infectum cell: l-marked recipients.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (89/127)

data.turoyo: W šqəlle ann=arbʕo=alfo=waroqe m a=tloṯo aḥunone, húwwalle tre=alfo=waroqe l u=šufer w tre=alfo huwwe l i=žənəke w l u=kurrəko w aḥ=ḥamməšmo=waroqe mfarqənne ʕal ḥḏoḏe l at=taḥarriye.
data.translation: Und sie nahmen den drei Brüdern die viertausend Pfundnoten ab, gaben zweitausend dem Chauffeur, Zweitausend der Frau und dem Jungen, und fünf Hundert verteilten die Polizisten unter sich.

rationale: Thin II Preterit cell: reciprocal distribution among the overt l-marked police agents.

summary: example for sense 6 in Infectum (Jan 1.8/336)

summary: example for sense 5 in Preterit (Jan 1.38/1563)

rationale: Thin round-1 I.5 Preterit cell; overt first-person l-series with mən-source.

summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (Jan 1.8/158)

rationale: Thin Detransitive 2 Infectum cell; prospective reciprocal parting. The machine English does not explicitly render m ḥḏoḏe; Turoyo is decisive.

summary: example for sense 3 in Infectum (Jan 2.4/1073)

data.turoyo: U naʕimo lə koḏəʕ, lə kforəq b mede.
data.translation: A child does not know, does not distinguish anything.

rationale: Thin I.3 Infectum cell; b-coded stimulus compared with round-1 noticed person.

summary: example for sense 3 in Infectum (Jan 4.I/107)

data.turoyo: Ǧan, i mġalṯayḏox Nsibin, i naqla ḥa d madla b iḏe, koforəq d kit fəršono bayn i mġalṯo d Nsibin w a mġale ḥrene d kit bayn u ʕamayḏan.
data.translation: Jan, your magazine Nsibin, when one takes it in one's hands, one notices that there is a difference between the magazine Nsibin and the other magazines that exist among our people.

rationale: Thin I.3 Infectum cell; propositional stimulus d kit fəršono and generic experiencer.

summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (Jan 4.I/593)

data.turoyo: W mən towuto! W mayna gabo, madam koxədmutu u ʕamano, ono mərli oṯuroyo, səryoyo lə kfərqo aʕli.
data.translation: And whoever you may be! And from whichever side, as long as you serve this people, I said, Assyrian, Syriac, it makes no difference to me.

rationale: Thin I.2 Infectum cell brought to four after round 1; aʕli explicitly names the person to whom the distinction makes no difference.

summary: example for sense 3 in Preterit (Jan 4.II/835)

data.turoyo: Frəqli b mede ḥreno ste ʕal d aḥnoni ste d kətte ḥawrone ʕlayme, uuu koṯən lu bayto baǧ ǧəvatat w koməǧġəlina naqqawoṯe.
data.translation: I noticed something else too, because my brothers too have young male friends, um, they come to the house at gatherings, and sometimes we talk.

rationale: Existing I.3 Preterit has three; adds first-person experiencer with explicit b-stimulus.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (Jan 2.4/515)

data.turoyo: Ṯeni yawmo m ṣafro azzano lu qolordi, mfarəqlelan. Ax xašune həwile l Ḥaywan Xaṣṭaxanasi
data.translation: The next day in the morning we went to corps headquarters; he separated us. He assigned the strong ones to the Animal Hospital.

rationale: Thin II.1 Preterit cell; adjacent assignment clause verifies personnel distribution.

summary: I.3 shows L-series experiencer in Preterit, optionally with b-coded target and a ki-clause (29/431), or just a propositional stimulus (30/139). Its Infectum counterpart lo+forəq ebe (MAC MuA Quzko/59) supports the same noticing/recognition meaning.

New I.4 has a discriminating agent, compared nominal objects and m-ḥḏoḏe. Generic second person and negative contexts do not make it impersonal. MAC Ishaq old houses/86 remains a possible boundary with I.1 physical separation; no example from that verse is added.

Active I.5 departure contrasts with Detransitive 2, attested in Preterit friqi, Infectum and counterfactual Infectum-wa. The direct person complement in 89/104 is a valency difference from Detransitive mene.

II Detransitive kmifarqo introduces agentless distribution, distinct from I Detransitive separation. Infectum-wa Mfarqiwunne has habitual active distribution. Source forms and inherited wording are preserved, including the supplied (+det) annotation in 57/124.

Jan Beṯ-Şawoce has no edition translation. English quotations below retain the supplied project machine translation and are marked as such; sense decisions rest on the Turoyo. Where available, round-1 proposals are retained in the human layout and counts, and are not resubmitted in this JSON.
Round 1 already supplied I Detransitive Preterit and II Infectum-wa, so readers’ repeated absent-box claims are stale. No structural proposal repeats them.
Cognitive I.3 noticing takes b-stimuli or a proposition; I.4 compares entities. Impersonal I.2 difference has aʕli experiencer and does not become noticing merely because it concerns ethnonyms.

II distribution retains l- and ʕal recipients, extends to people and administrative aid, and permits recipient-plus-theme suffixes (mfarqiwolanyo). No light-verb collocation is established by these verses.

At 1.36/1509 mfaraqwolle is provisionally retained as Preterit-wa; 3.36/1026,1028 mfaraqwolən are provisionally retained as Infectum-wa. Vowel/suffix ambiguity prevents use of these as form-establishing examples. No automatic correction to either paradigm is justified.

Confirm whether MAC Ishaq old houses/86 lo+kfərqatle denotes physical separation (I.1), cognitive discrimination (new I.4), or both; its neighbouring frš clauses favour discrimination but are not decisive.
Confirm segmentation and participant coding of friqili (89/28); retain provisional Detransitive Preterit 2 without another example.
Confirm that (+det) in the supplied 57/124 verse is editorial annotation and how it should be displayed in the final edition; it has not been silently removed.
Check the old prs page/line concordance for the fox-sign and meat-distribution quotations; no replacement with current text/verse numbering is assumed.
Confirm mfaraqwolle (1.36/1509) and mfaraqwolən (3.36/1026,1028): Preterit-wa l-agent versus Infectum-wa with object/recipient suffix? Does singular huwe at 1026 govern the latter?
At 1.39/1748 does fərqatte denote distinguishing communities, treating them differently, or separating them politically? Final I.4 is provisional and no example is selected.
At 1.21/1042 confirm whether frəqno is reduced Detransitive Preterit or an active intransitive form; preserve the reader’s Detransitive 2 provisionally without a new example.
At 1.36/1492 does -nne resume aid goods or beneficiaries? At 1.39/1746 verify the reduced frəqənne form with feminine ḥkume.
Correct German 'ware' to 'wäre'
rationale: The counterfactual clause requires wäre; the supplied edition also reads gewesen wäre.

summary: A person can refrain from treating someone differently from a daughter (gfuraqla mi barṯo); retain this personal comparison alongside impersonal difference.
Distribution extends from money/meat to coffee, buttermilk and festive foods. l- and ʕal mark recipients; the nominal theme may be omitted.
Conscripts can be distributed to postings or separated for transport, with -lan indexing people, whereas food/aid is the ordinary theme. No separate personnel sense is required.
frəqalli mənayye confirms the round-1 active departure sense with l-series morphology, beside reciprocal Detransitive frəqina me ḥḏoḏe.
Round-1 discrimination is supported by contrast between the terms Safarbarlək and Sayfo. bayn marks the comparison without physical separation.
